npcs.name: Rhea
npcs.greeting: Rhea looks up from a tray of drying seed heads. "Watercress likes cold feet. Did you know that?"
npcs.farewell: "Bring me what the river gives you."

quests.title: Cold Feet
quests.description: Rhea wants proof that watercress grows in a raised bed, not just in the river shallows.

outcomes.label: Add your seed to her library
outcomes.summary: Rhea files your watercress seed with a note about the bed it came from.

storyLog.label: Add your seed to her library
storyLog.summary: Your watercress joins Rhea's seed library.

outcomes.label: Trade notes on bed moisture
outcomes.summary: You and Rhea compare how wet each of you keeps the soil.

storyLog.label: Trade notes on bed moisture
storyLog.summary: Rhea's moisture notes go in your journal.

zones.name: Riverside Lean To
zones.description: A small seed drying lean to beside the path.
